name: blackveil
description: A private bank for people and their AI agents, settled in USDG on Robinhood Chain: handles, requests to pay, and agent vaults under a mandate the contract enforces.

scripts.check: for f in server.mjs server/*.mjs public/js/*.js public/sdk/*.mjs tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'syntax ok'
scripts.test:fork: cd contracts && forge test -vv --match-contract Fork --fork-url https://robinhood-rpc.publicnode.com
scripts.verify:bytecode: cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && node tools/compare-bytecode.mjs
